introHtml: Paper luggage ID tags offer a lightweight, cost-effective solution for trade shows, conferences, and group travel. Unlike plastic or metal tags, paper tags are easy to write on and can be fully customized with your logo, event details, or barcodes. The Tuscany™ Luggage Tag, for example, provides a classic look with a durable paper stock that holds up to standard travel handling. Perfect for giveaways or temporary identification, these tags keep your brand visible without the bulk or expense of permanent materials.
